feature_policy: calendar-contiguous raw closes + splits/dividends; 21/61 closes; volatility simple total-return daily std ddof=0 sqrt(252)
preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted on training rows only; no imputation; no post-fit calibration
purge: training rows must have assumed_label_available_at <= training_as_of; no future training folds
embargo: validation/test observations require entry >= 65 calendar sessions after prior partition end; validation never used to fit test model
label_availability: assumed historical only: exit + 5 sessions close; real historical vendor availability not established
candidate_refit: same parameters; all eligible cutoffs through 2026-06-27 with labels mature by actual run time
reporting: point estimates, full planned denominators, scored coverage, missing reasons, fixed 10-bin calibration; no CI/p-values
stopping_rule: one candidate, one validation/test report per horizon; no tuning/restarts based on results; retain failures and negative effects
limitations: current vendor revisions lack historical source timestamps
current ticker mapping does not prove all historical identities
